_about: Exact, explained differences between Dungeon Atlas shared room-link rules and the pinned b28 Oracle room_data.py reference. The golden binds id, field, oracle value and yaze value, and rejects unexpected differences or stale entries. October 12: nine differences in three rooms from the archived Oracle script omitting sprite-caused floor drops. Warp-tag quadrant destinations retain their existing presentation. The original 296-room/203-edge reference and all assertions remain unchanged.

diffs.reason: The pinned b28 sprite stream at PC 0x4D715 is 00 05 17 D6 FF: ordinary sprite 0xD6 (Ganon falling floor), not an overlord. The existing shared classifier makes holewarp 0x1F -> 0x1E strong. The archived room_data.py lines 151-158 omit this sprite cause from its pit-detail filter. Atlas presents it as a pit link; the golden derives pits and cross-area flags from that link.
